title: Customer and item posting fields fit decision
purpose: Decide the next narrow W1 Foundation step from TARGET-042 field evidence before any O2C/P2P document, Preview Posting or Posting.
entryCriteria: TARGET-042 observed U-CUST-100 and U-ITEM-HW100 card contexts read-only in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
TARGET-042 produced fieldSummary for customer and item.
No setup, master data, document, Preview Posting or Posting was changed by TARGET-042.
acceptanceCriteria: The decision names exactly one next narrow case.
The decision does not unlock O2C/P2P documents.
The decision separates field visibility, missing UI fields and actual setup correctness.
If field visibility is insufficient, the next case is UI/Page Inspection/personalization discovery rather than a write gate.
If setup writes become necessary later, they require a separate Smart Decision with exact fields and values.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-042 proves U-CUST-100 and U-ITEM-HW100 card contexts read-only. Customer posting/VAT/payment fields were not visible in compact card text; item Base Unit, Lagerbuchungsgruppe, Produktbuchungsgruppe and inventory signals were visible, but no setup value correctness is proven.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: A direct O2C preflight is still too early because customer posting/VAT fields and item VAT/costing signals need either UI discovery or an explicit setup-fit decision first.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: TARGET-042 suggests missing fields may be hidden by FastTabs/layout/personalization rather than absent setup; read-only UI discovery should come before a write gate.
A write case needs exact visible fields and intended values.
O2C still depends on customer/item posting fields, VAT boundary and expected entry trace.
Vendor creation remains parked and is separate from customer/item O2C readiness.

queueChangesMade: TARGET-043 created as a local fit-decision gate after TARGET-042.
nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It can check hidden FastTabs, personalization and Page Inspection without writing values, reducing the risk of a premature setup write.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not edit customer or item fields from field visibility alone.
Do not claim posting readiness until setup values and Preview Posting are proven.
requiredPreparation: Inspect card layout/FastTabs/Page Inspection before deciding a field is unavailable.
Keep Preview Posting and Posting locked.
